title: [main] features 640066 Add integration events for events for CZ Adv. Payment and CZ Cash Desk
summary: Integration events added for Czech advance payment and cash desk functionality to allow customization of validation and lookup behavior on cash document lines, with optional skipping of amount field validation.
key_points: OnBeforeValidateAdvanceLetterNoCZZ and OnBeforeLookupAdvanceLetterNoCZZ events enable subscriber override of advance letter number handling
SkipAmountsTestFields parameter added to OnBeforeCheckMandatoryFields event for selective validation bypass
Non-breaking change preserving default behavior when no subscribers are active
Comprehensive test cases verify event triggering and amount validation skipping
Enables partners to customize advance payment processing for specific business needs
quote: Added the OnBeforeValidateAdvanceLetterNoCZZ and OnBeforeLookupAdvanceLetterNoCZZ integration events.
